limits: One serial run per arm on one fixed 30-input/29-tracking prefix; no repeat, confidence interval, randomized order, occlusion coverage, or general deployment speed claim.
All input, output and private-head signature checks are exact dtype/shape/bytes or exact scalar equality. No tolerance is used to pass differences.

This is a new pair with one common outer observer. Both arms omit only per-tensor full-model hash child spans while still executing all original full-model hashes and guards. Span count, every label call count, frame/callback IDs and parent topology are independently compared.
Full-model outer hash calls remain 221 overall and 220 in tracking. Both arms have the same recorded child-span coverage; full_model_tensor_copy_hash is absent in both.
Inclusive stages overlap. surface_total contains 90 evidence_sink_total spans in each arm; sink includes NPZ compression. Do not sum these stages.
CUDA event values are stream elapsed intervals including possible host gaps, not summed kernel times.
Tracking uses all 29 saved frame latencies; parent wall includes child startup, initialization and inherited source/asset gates. They are different timing boundaries.
Peak GPU allocation/reservation and process RSS cover the entire child, without resetting; initialization may determine the peak.
The original fixed30 reference was recorded earlier; exact checked output parity does not imply general determinism.
Private parameter evidence compares all before/next head digest signatures and full proposal scalar values; the audit does not independently rerun optimization.
Targeted parity and timing integrity do not replace full raw transfer/current-gate replay or GT accuracy evaluation. No GT was read.
No images, pose matrices, model, weights, raw GT, runtime source or logs are included in this public package.
